text_block_list.text:
The much anticipated Japanese Derby is
here,
and the entire audience is focused
on the
long-awaited showdown between
the BNW trio.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Prior to the race, Бива Хаяхидэ senses

something peculiar about Winning
Ticket, just
like with Нарита Таисин at
the Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит's dream is to win the
Derby. Her
focus has been so singular
that she's been
isolating herself to train
for it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Бива Хаяхидэ tries to convince herself
that she
can pin down the source of that
strange feeling as
she heads out to the
race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
